item.title: London Lions enjoy winning weekend as men remain unbeaten and women get off the mark
item.description: London Lions enjoyed a winning weekend as the men beat Cheshire Phoenix to stay unbeaten and the women swept aside Nottingham Wildcats for their first league win.

item.title: London Lions Women beaten by Caledonia Gladiators despite spirited fightback
item.description: London Lions Women suffered a 76-58 home defeat to Caledonia Gladiators despite a determined second-quarter fightback at NCC Hackney.
